worked.problem: For y = sin(1x), determine the period in degrees.
actions: Start with the parent y = sin x; its period is 360°.
The factor k = 1 changes how rapidly the input angle is traversed.
Plot the parent and transformed graphs together over −360° to 360°.
One cycle of y = sin(1x) takes 360° ÷ 1 = 360°.
Answer: period = 360°. Check the transformed graph repeats after a horizontal shift of 360°.
